title: Full of · phrase
subtitle: 「充滿／裝滿／塞滿／富含」，究竟是哪一種 full of？
description: 「充滿／裝滿／塞滿／富含」，究竟是哪一種 full of？

words.note: 使用者提供。filled with 是 full of 最直接、最中性的改寫之一，既可表示容器或空間實際裝有某物，也可表示場景、文字或情緒中存在大量某事物。它不一定強調擁擠或過量。
words.example: The room was filled with natural light.

exercises.original: The hall was full of smoke after the small fire.
exercises.zh: 小火災後，大廳充滿煙霧。
exercises.upgrade: filled with · 充滿；裝滿；滿是

options.explanation: hall + smoke describes a space containing a substance; no special sense of crowding or abundance is required.
強調密度高、內容多、幾乎沒有多餘空間。 本題的決定性線索是 a space containing a substance；這裡需要的是「中性的『充滿／裝滿』」。因此 packed with 雖也可表示 abundance，但密度、是否涉及活物、正式程度、是否超出容量或是否強調成分含量並不最吻合。
常與 enthusiasm, confidence, excitement, ideas 等搭配，帶『滿到邊緣』的生動比喻。 本題的決定性線索是 a space containing a substance；這裡需要的是「中性的『充滿／裝滿』」。因此 brimming with 雖也可表示 abundance，但密度、是否涉及活物、正式程度、是否超出容量或是否強調成分含量並不最吻合。
比 brimming 更強，常暗示數量已超出正常容量。 本題的決定性線索是 a space containing a substance；這裡需要的是「中性的『充滿／裝滿』」。因此 overflowing with 雖也可表示 abundance，但密度、是否涉及活物、正式程度、是否超出容量或是否強調成分含量並不最吻合。
較口語，常與 sugar, calories, detail, features, extras 等搭配。 本題的決定性線索是 a space containing a substance；這裡需要的是「中性的『充滿／裝滿』」。因此 loaded with 雖也可表示 abundance，但密度、是否涉及活物、正式程度、是否超出容量或是否強調成分含量並不最吻合。

words.note: brimming with 原本指液體滿到容器邊緣，常比喻一個人或場景充滿 enthusiasm, confidence, excitement, ideas 等正面或強烈狀態。它比普通 full of 更有『滿到邊緣』的形象感。
words.example: She was brimming with confidence before the interview.

falseSynonyms.zh: 兩者最接近；filled with 中性描述內容，而 full of 語域更廣。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The room was filled with light. The box was full of books.

falseSynonyms.zh: packed with 強調密度高、內容多或幾乎沒有空位；普通 full of 未必如此擁擠。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The train was packed with commuters. The room was full of light.

falseSynonyms.zh: brimming with 常帶生動『滿到邊緣』意味，特別常配 enthusiasm/confidence/ideas。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She was brimming with confidence. The drawer was full of cables.

falseSynonyms.zh: overflowing with 比 full of 更強，通常表示數量多到超過正常容量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The basket was overflowing with fruit. The box was full of letters.

falseSynonyms.zh: teeming with 幾乎只用於大量活物或活躍人群；一般物件、情緒不能機械替換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The reef was teeming with fish. The report was full of detail.

falseSynonyms.zh: rich in 強調成分、營養、資源或資訊含量高；不等於容器被裝滿。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The soil is rich in minerals. The bag is full of clothes.

falseSynonyms.zh: covered with 表示某物表面被覆蓋；full of 表示內部或整體含有大量。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The table was covered with papers. The drawer was full of papers.

falseSynonyms.zh: full of 是片語；fullness 是名詞，表示充滿狀態或飽足感，不能直接互換。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The room is full of people. He complained of a feeling of fullness.
